entry.author: 1News
entry.summary:
This week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient is Erina “Edz” Wehi‑Barton of Te Kūiti, a tireless community leader whose generosity and drive strengthen the whole town. 

Edz is the President of the local Waka Ama Club, leading more than 80 members and creating opportunities for tamariki to compete at a national level while promoting health, wellbeing, environmental care, and Te Reo Māori. When resources are scarce, Edz steps in. She maintains and repairs the waka and equipment, often teaching herself and others new skills to keep the club running. 

Beyond sport, Edz is a constant presence across the community, thought of as the Marae "Mrs Fix It", running educational seminars, supporting whānau, driving buses, and repairing essential services. Studying toward a PhD while working and training, Edz’s impact is defined by aroha, mahi, and unwavering service. ASB is proud to recognise Edz with $10,000 as this week’s ASB Good as Gold recipient.
